PRIMARY.description: Train on EC+BS+PA (the three primary hosts), matched to the main-library configuration used for the core benchmark.

SECONDARY.description: Train on EC+PA only (drop weak-coverage B. subtilis). Higher N. Framed as the deeper-phylogenetic-distance variant: both training hosts are Gram-negative Proteobacteria, so held-out transfer to C. glutamicum (Actinobacteria, Gram-positive) tests a larger phylogenetic jump than the PRIMARY config.
